Right now you have two choices.

  1. LineageOS which is a fork of android with all the google crap removed. Not bad but requires work on your part to install and keep it running. Installing some apps is either a PITA or impossible.

  2. SailfishOS. This is closer to what you're calling a Linux phone. But they're not making hardware any more. Either buy a used phone or a specific Sony and install it yourself. Not bad but it's not really consumer friendly yet.
Because smartphones were designed to be unable to run a free system.
